title: TankHead
provenance: Reported by zn2m4swhkv-sys (highball-db#348, 2026-10-05), a copy from outside Steam in its own environment, Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.8, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r20 (D3DMetal 4), rated 3 of 5. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable with workarounds at a low frame rate on an M2, an Unreal Engine game. The player's setup: the D3DMetal 4 engine r20 with D3DM_MTL4=1 (Metal 4 back end, which the engine turns off by default because it stops some Unreal 5 games) and D3DM_ENABLE_METALFX=1, nvapi64,nvngx=n,b so the game's DLSS option maps to MetalFX, Windows 11, AVX advertised, a 120 fps cap in Highball with the real cap set in game, and Engine.ini settings under AppData/Local/TankHead/Saved/Config/Windows (r.GTSyncType=1, r.OneFrameThreadLag=0, s.AsyncLoadingThreadEnabled=1, r.ShaderPipelineCache.Enabled=1 with BatchSize 10, fx.MaxNiagaraCPUParticlesPerEmitter=0, r.Tonemapper.Quality=1, r.SSR.Quality=1). Which of these matter was not tested here.

knownIssues.cause: Reported on an M2, not measured here
knownIssues.fix: The player's settings in the notes made it playable; which of them help was not measured (highball-db#348)
